article.title: Clasificador prenda: 벌
article.chapter: Números, clasificadores, hora y fecha — 수사·단위명사·시간·날짜

claims.summary: The NIKL response says the Standard Korean Language Dictionary gives 벌 two senses: a unit for counting clothes, including a single clothing item, and a unit for counting a set of two or more clothing or dish items. It explicitly gives 티셔츠 한 벌, 바지 한 벌, and 양복 한 벌.

locator.source: National Institute of Korean Language, Online Q&A, “물건을 세는 단위,” answer dated 2026-02-28
locator.detail: Answer §1 quotes the Standard Korean Language Dictionary for the two bound-noun senses of 벌: a unit for counting clothes, and a unit for counting a group of two or more clothes or dishes. The answer states that 티셔츠 한 벌 and 바지 한 벌 count one clothing type/item, and 양복 한 벌 can count a set of pieces.

links.notes: Se corrigió la confusión entre contar una prenda y contar un conjunto; la definición citada y los tres ejemplos de la respuesta oficial respaldan ambos sentidos.
